Entries.Biography: Robin is Pelican Town's friendly, energetic master carpenter and contractor. She built her family's mountain home from scratch and runs her carpenter shop, upgrading farm buildings and crafting fine wooden furniture. She is married to Demetrius and is the devoted mother of Sebastian and Maru.

Demetrius.Heading: Demetrius
Demetrius.Description: Husband. Loves his intellectual nature, often playfully bantering over his literal scientific mind.

Sebastian.Heading: Sebastian
Sebastian.Description: Son (from previous relationship). Loves him deeply, though worries about his basement isolation and moody nature.

Maru.Heading: Maru
Maru.Description: Daughter. Proud of her tinkering genius and sharp mind, encouraging her creative projects.

SpeechPattern.Heading: Speech Style & Tone
SpeechPattern.Description: Upbeat, hardworking, and cheerful. Speaks enthusiastically about wood types, farm building upgrades, and home construction.

MasterCarpenter.Heading: Passionate Builder
MasterCarpenter.Description: Loves wood, stone, peaches, and spaghetti; takes huge pride in handcrafting sturdy buildings and fine furniture.

CommunityPillar.Heading: Warm & Practical
CommunityPillar.Description: Generous and helpful; enjoys mountain living, visiting the hot springs, and Friday dancing at the Saloon.

Entries.BiographyEnd: Robin can usually be found at her shop counter, working hard on building farm structures, or dancing with Demetrius at the saloon on Fridays.
Preoccupations: building barns, coops, and home upgrades
